name: Tsundere de Yandere na Osananajimi - Takanashi Futaba-san to H na Koto o Suru Game
original_name: ツンデレでヤンデレな幼馴染・小鳥遊双葉さんとＨなことをするゲーム
source:
Futaba is a high school student. She is smart, good at sports, and liked by everyone. One the other hand, Michiru, the main character, is just mediocre.... They are promised to marry..., though Futaba doesn't want it. One day, Michiru meets a beautiful girl, who has just transferred to their school. Futaba accidentally sees it and runs away angrily, but she stumbles and almost falls down the stairs. Michiru narrowly saves her, but he gets injured. As Futaba takes care of him, they gradually get closer and finally.... Happy ending? No, no. Hinako whom Michiru met the other day and Chidori, a school doctor, take part in the story and various H happenings and events happen! Also, Futaba is found to be yandere.... Will Michiru be able to get back a peaceful life?

translation:
双叶是一名高中生。她聪明、擅长运动、人见人爱。另一方面，主人公满只是一个普通人……他们被指腹为婚……尽管双叶并不情愿。某天，满遇到了一位刚转学来的美丽女孩。双叶偶然看到后愤怒地跑开，却绊了一下差点从楼梯上摔下去。满勉强救了她，但自己却受了伤。在双叶照顾他的过程中，两人渐渐亲近，终于……幸福结局？不不不。满前几天遇到的日奈子和校医千鸟也加入了故事，各种H事件接连发生！而且，双叶还被发现有病娇倾向……满能否找回平静的生活？
